replies.author: Myv
replies.body:
It is definitely getting there, however the map is quite flat and the block palette is inconsistent and quite boring in some places.

Try heightening or lowering some of the islands and make a more unique block palette, and also investigate with adding more islands.

replies.author: cellish
replies.body:
just one thing, make sure to go through everything that needs to be there to get your map accepted before you post it.

With this I mean:
- Space for pvp
- Detail
- amount of void
- If it's unique or not
- If it looks very similiar to another map
- etc..


Just to get you on point so you don't have to post your map on the forums too many times.

Thanks!"

-Sam
